protocol.sampling_rule: earliest RGB in each epoch-relative floor((timestamp-first_rgb)*Hz) bin; do not remove source images
protocol.gt_association: nearest pose, earlier pose tie break; offline evaluation only; no pose interpolation; many RGB may share one pose
protocol.gallery_rule: sampled valid-GT frames strictly before midpoint of full raw RGB time span
protocol.query_rule: sampled frames at least 10 seconds after the raw time midpoint; retain all invalid GT and no-positive records
protocol.positive_rule: Euclidean distance between nearest-associated optical camera centers <= radius; no orientation filter
protocol.common_evaluation_rule: same query rows for all methods; startup remains in denominator with declared single-frame fallback; invalid GT counted separately
protocol.open_set_reporting: radius-specific no-positive counts, total coverage, per-method rejection count; default no rejection and explicitly no calibrated open-set detector
protocol.weights: reuse existing frozen adapters/checkpoints with exact fingerprints
protocol.gt_duplicate_policy: use first original pose row for an exact duplicate timestamp; retain all original rows/evidence
protocol.gt_unit: metres: optical camera center in TUM mocap world
protocol.rejection_policy: no rejection; 100% valid query attempted; no open-set detection claim
protocol.invalid_query_history_policy: all sampled queries processed including invalid-GT; metrics mask only invalid GT, not difficult/open queries

evaluation.timing_selection: all mandatory families plus developer-selected strongest and matched-pool controls; no test-derived method selection
evaluation.online_accuracy_audit: report all cached/batch-one differences, no claim of equality unless measured

preprocessing.setting: protocol full-image low-resolution warp; not original paper reproduction

source.initialization_adaptation: Official GeoLocalizationNet_ and forward; bypass overwritten CosPlace initializer, strict-load every tensor from the complete official EigenPlaces checkpoint.
